dog.description_text:
Meet Muffin!

Muffin was surrendered when his owner could no longer care for him, and this playful, social boy is ready to find his next chapter! He loves being around his people, approaches readily with a wagging tail, and happily follows his handler around. Muffin has lots of personality and is looking for someone who will enjoy helping him put his best paw forward.

My Ideal Home

Muffin will do best with a family who can give him plenty of physical and mental enrichment, along with positive reinforcement training. He enjoys being playful and will appreciate walks, interactive toys, and a variety of fun chews to keep his curious mind and busy body occupied. A patient adopter who enjoys helping a dog learn will be a great match for this sweet guy.

Good with Other Pets?

Muffin was playful with a familiar dog in his previous home. When meeting a new dog, he initially took some time to warm up before engaging in mutual sniffing, and he became quite enthusiastic about interacting with his canine friend. Slow, supervised introductions will help Muffin get comfortable and learn good social manners with new dogs.

Good with Kids?

Muffin would do best in a home without children under 13. He can be enthusiastic when seeking treats and attention and is still working on gentle treat taking and keeping his mouth to himself, so older, dog savvy family members will be the best fit.

Things to Know

Muffin has a few things he'll be working on with his new family, including jumping up, mouthiness when seeking treats, and feeling protective of his food. He should always be given space while eating, and anything he needs to give up should be traded for something he really loves rather than taken directly from him. He can also be a little startled by unfamiliar things, so moving at his pace and using treats, toys, and praise will help him feel safe and confident. With consistency, patience, and plenty of appropriate outlets for his energy, Muffin has all the ingredients to be a wonderful companion!
